intent.proves: Translations of products, field labels and list options: text-differs satisfies the selected profile assertion.
intent.scope: Legacy registry scope; defaultLanguage/pimShop/productScope tokens where present. Global scans remain global.

bindings.reason: Requires complete joins and raw/fallback semantics parity before this binding may execute.

bindings.query: SELECT ISNULL(100 * SUM(CASE WHEN ISNULL(CAST(t.ProductLongDescription AS nvarchar(max)), N'') <> N'' AND CAST(t.ProductLongDescription AS nvarchar(max)) <> ISNULL(CAST(d.ProductLongDescription AS nvarchar(max)), N'') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 0) FROM EcomProducts t JOIN EcomProducts d ON d.ProductId = t.ProductId AND d.ProductVariantId = t.ProductVariantId AND d.ProductLanguageId = N'{lang}' WHERE t.ProductLanguageId <> N'{lang}' AND ISNULL(t.ProductVariantId, N'') = N''
